title: LawBench: Benchmarking Legal Knowledge of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking legal knowledge, understanding, and application within the Chinese civil-law system. While legal tasks inherently involve concepts of justice, the benchmark's tasks are not designed to evaluate an LLM's understanding of faith, morals, or general ethical principles as distinct from legal rules and reasoning. There is no dedicated component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics beyond the application of law.
